comment: Dr. Wen is a wonderful professor who cares a lot about her students. However, the exams are considerably harder than the quizzes, so make sure you study enough for the exams. Seeing Dr. Wen during office hours definitely helps. There are plenty of opportunities for extra credit, so be sure to take advantage of them, and you'll be just fine.

Dr. Wen is a good and caring professor; I just sucked at this subject. I highly recommend taking the extra time in this course to understand the material at a deep and conceptual level. Make sure to utilize office hours if possible. I found tests are much more difficult than the quizzes, so put lots of time into studying before each one!

This course is definitely hard. Dr Wen's teaching skills are great, cares about students but the class is not easy to follow, as the material itself is very hard. The exams are very difficult especially the final. There are practice problems but are not correlate with the real exams. If you don't have to take this course then definitely skip it.

Dr. Wen is a great new addition to the math department! Her class was structured very well with weekly quizzes and homework for constant feedback. She gives you extra resources before tests and is always receptive to questions. However, her assessments do require a high level of understanding, but she does prepare you for it.
